contracts: PRG007 holds the real 2560 render completion after the last cancellation check in both Original/Processed directions; the opposite UI mode publishes its independent CPU pixels before the original held callback is rejected exactly once.

PRG008 accepts one actual final preset-hover result while hover stays active without persistence; a second actual final hover result is delivered after leaving and rejected by the original guard. Catalog/document/history/selection and original hashes remain unchanged.

Neither scenario fabricates callbacks or renderer pixels. Existing test-only dispatch probe is reused; actual stale callbacks run through the existing production revision guard. CPU image rendering isolates ordering; Qt Metal scene tests are separate.

Full bounded functional baseline: 264 PASS, 1 FAIL, 427 SKIPPED and 78 NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Skipped/unadapted cases never count as qualified. The failure is PRS017 after pasting an exact saved Light subset.

Three fresh unchanged-oracle PRS017 runs reproduce one RGB byte difference with exact alpha. Each captured actual image equals fresh actual Metal replay byte-for-byte; each expected image equals fresh CPU replay byte-for-byte. Linear error 2.38419e-7 is below the unchanged fixed tolerance (worst ratio 0.005904). Original catalogs are read-only; replay uses SQLite backups.

The pre-existing MetalDevelopTests/WB RGB <= 1 and alpha-exact allowance is shared with preset readiness only when Metal is enabled and the document is GPU-compatible. CPU-only/incompatible paths remain exact. Complete settings/history/UUID/persistence assertions are unchanged.

Shared pixel controls reject RGB 2, alpha changes, missing pixels, wrong geometry, channel format, color space and DPR. Equal bytes cannot bypass metadata checks. Failure PNG/JSON evidence is retained.
The full CTest baseline has 61 PASS and one absent-private-Nikon RAW SKIP. It ran with offscreen/software UI environment; named native tests are not reclassified as real window qualification.
